cost_rule: 2 x n physical hands per query (candidate + incumbent rollouts); unpaired queries cost the same
query_cost_note: one fixed-size (4096-hand) paired query = 8192 physical hands; used by the analyze_v4 cross-check only
randomised_comparator_evaluation: uniform_fixed: exact expectation over all query subsets; uniform_small: mean of 64 seeded draws; the pre-registered single draw is also reported
design_rationale: v2b showed that with a one-dimensional candidate ray and a binary latent type, every posterior-guided rule (EVSI, IVR, LUCB) issues identical queries. v4 makes candidate informativeness heterogeneous (five directions, three step sizes on the main direction), adds a query-size menu so cost-aware acquisition is exercised, stores per-hand outcomes so paired vs unpaired estimation and repeated queries can be evaluated on the same sealed hands, and adds two noisy audit blocks so calibration from realistic audits can be tested. Proxy and deployment values remain exact; scoring uses exact values only.

pilot_go_criteria.G1_best_candidate_differs_by_type: GO/NO-GO: argmax over candidates+incumbent of the type-mean exact long deployment delta differs between the two latent types
pilot_go_criteria.G2a_definition: GO/NO-GO: in equilibrator pilot worlds, mean number of candidates (incl. the best) whose exact long deployment delta lies within 1.96 SE_i(4096 paired hands) of the world's best must be >= 2, i.e. the within-type selection is not trivial and needs HF evidence
pilot_go_criteria.G2b_definition: GO/NO-GO: in equilibrator pilot worlds, mean best exact long deployment delta over the incumbent must exceed 3 x mean SE(4096), i.e. there is resolvable value to find
pilot_go_criteria.G3_reported_only: type-separation / SE heterogeneity ratios at 4096 and at the smallest query size; number of candidates below 1.96 SE and above 5 SE
pilot_go_criteria.stop_if_fail: if G1, G2a or G2b fails: stop, report as a design failure, do not tune candidates/eta/hands
